description: Defines IPC message structures, classes for data frames, input/output handling, and message types for RPC communication within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: Data::Frame
classes.description: Represents a data frame with serialization/deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: Data::Input
classes.description: Handles input message data, including validation and setting message parameters.

classes.name: Data::Output
classes.description: Handles output message data, including adding implementations and serialization.

classes.name: Data::Init
classes.description: Represents initialization message with different types (ACQUIRE, OFFER, REVOKE, REQUEST).

classes.name: Data::Setup
classes.description: Represents setup configuration data for messaging, including implementation, sequence, and categories.

methods.name: instance_cast
methods.description: Converts various incoming types to Core::instance_id, accommodating 32/64-bit systems.

methods.name: Frame::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes frame data into a stream starting from a given offset.

methods.name: Frame::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a stream into the frame starting from a given offset.

methods.name: Input::Set
methods.description: Sets message data with implementation, interface ID, and method ID.

methods.name: Input::Implementation
methods.description: Retrieves the implementation ID from the message data.

methods.name: Input::InterfaceId
methods.description: Retrieves the interface ID from the message data.

methods.name: Input::MethodId
methods.description: Retrieves the method ID from the message data.

methods.name: Output::AddImplementation
methods.description: Adds an implementation, ID, and mode to the output data.

methods.name: Init::Set
methods.description: Configures the Init message with various parameters depending on the message type.

methods.name: Setup::Set
methods.description: Sets up the configuration with implementation, sequence number, and categories.
